description: Plaintext signals exchanged between nodes, sealed inside is.neuros.descale.relay.sendSignal payloads. Each plaintext is one of the objects below, identified by its $type.

offer.description: Starts or restarts a connection. The offerer takes the ICE controlling role. If both sides offer at once, the offer from the lower node ID wins.

createdAt.description: Recipients drop signals more than 60 seconds old.

answer.description: Accepts an offer, after the handshake check and peer validation pass.

candidate.description: An ICE candidate found after the offer or answer was sent.

records.description: Signed network records sent directly to a peer whose network repo is behind. Verify each exactly like a record read from the repo.

sessionId.description: Random ID chosen by the offerer; shared by every signal of one connection attempt.

iceCandidate.description: An ICE candidate in SDP attribute form (RFC 8839), e.g. 'candidate:1 1 udp 2130706431 192.0.2.1 41641 typ host'.

syncState.description: Compared during the handshake check. On a mismatch, the side that's behind syncs before continuing.

revocationsDigest.description: SHA-256 over the sorted, newline-joined did:keys of all revocations currently held.
